observed_current_system.compiler_behavior: Numeric authority is compiled from a separately maintained historical source_numeric_facts list, rebound to current target_id and source_record_id, then extended by one hard-coded TSMC repair fact and one market PIT fact.
observed_current_system.model_view_behavior: The current fixed-pack input exposes complete source_text for each selected SourceMaterial while NumericFactView covers only the separate fact inventory.
observed_current_system.final_guard_behavior: The deterministic final guard correctly rejects material numeric surfaces that cannot be bound to the compiled authority, even when the source text contains the number.
observed_current_system.business_effect: Evidence expansion can improve research while simultaneously making more true source numbers visible but not deliverable.

concrete_findings.defect: The selected Evidence target contains four decision-relevant numeric surfaces, but the separate authority inventory does not co-compile all four and does not bind the source-rounded 16.1 surface to the exact 16.132 fact.
The 97.8% surface is relevant to the selected competition facet but absent from the current authority inventory.
A whole-table all-number extractor would also promote dozens of unrelated cells; selection must preserve row, column, unit, period and slot meaning.
Regex-all extraction can misclassify date punctuation, rule numbers and product names as financial facts.
The contract must represent temporal ranges and qualitative numeric bands, not only Decimal scalars.

option_assessment.reason: Adding 51.3, 5000 and 97.8 one by one repeats the same dual-ledger defect and cannot generalize when the Evidence Pack changes.
It would authorize unrelated table cells, dates, filing rules, product model numbers, footnotes and cross-facet context; source presence is not sufficient financial authority.

It keeps the financial control plane provider-neutral, derives authority from the actual selected Evidence, preserves structured lineage and lets stronger future models receive more autonomy without changing the product truth boundary.

design_principles: selected Evidence and numeric authority have one compilation transaction and one input digest
raw source capture remains immutable private audit evidence and is never itself output authority
candidate discovery may be broad but promotion is deterministic and target-aware
the local renderer owns value, unit, period, currency, rounding and formula surfaces but does not write the research thesis
the model owns analysis, mechanism, counter-thesis and prose within the compiled fact boundary
an unbound model number remains L1 even when an inventory omission also exists
no provider-specific branch is added to the core contract
data_flow: SelectedEvidence and its exact source or structured-metric coordinates enter one co-compilation transaction
source-aware extractors emit MaterialNumericCandidate rows only for selected Evidence targets
a deterministic adjudicator resolves entity, metric, period, unit, currency, slot, facet, relationship and output boundary
a stable fact resolver merges exact, rounded, converted and formatted surfaces for the same economic fact
a presentation program compiles NUM and FORM refs plus source-surface receipts
node-specific model views expose authorized refs and local non-output annotations or masking
the final local guard rechecks rendered surfaces, explicit refs and Evidence lineage after semantic model verification
selected_design.stable_fact_identity: case_key + entity + semantic_metric_key + period_or_as_of + canonical_unit + authoritative_source_scope
selected_design.lineage_identity: evidence_target_id + source_record_id + exact source coordinate or structured table path
selected_design.presentation_rule: Exact source values, official rounded surfaces, deterministic unit conversions and formula outputs are presentations of one stable fact when their receipt proves equivalence; they are not independent hand-authored aliases.

model_view_contract.private_audit_view: Preserve the complete immutable raw request, source response and assistant output under restricted access; never treat raw presence as promotion authority.
model_view_contract.research_lead_and_specialist_view: Expose bounded selected Evidence context, slot and facet meaning, authorized candidate refs and colocated context-only or forbidden annotations. Do not expose unannotated full-source numeric surfaces.
model_view_contract.writer_view: Expose authorized NUM and FORM refs plus bounded nonnumeric narrative. Replace context-only numeric spans with stable local labels or explicit DO_NOT_OUTPUT markers; ambiguous spans are masked.
model_view_contract.verifier_view: Expose compact claims, explicit refs, Evidence support and relevant boundaries; semantic pass cannot override the local numeric gate.
model_view_contract.future_dynamic_request_boundary: S3 may later let a model request an additional numeric target by entity, metric, period and slot, but the request cannot directly authorize or render a value.

promotion_order: deterministic numeric identity period unit currency ref and lineage verification complete

DELL: narrative orders revenue backlog and customer counts
PIT market input without target-price authority
MU: price shipment mix and capacity periods
NVDA: issuer revenue margin and cash metrics
ORCL: USD millions and exact table path
company-wide metric cannot become AI-specific attribution
ASML: Q1 versus Q2 and product-mix identity
ANET: company-wide value cannot become AI-network attribution

mutation_suite: same numeric surface with different semantic metrics
same stable fact with exact and official rounded surfaces
same metric with different entity period unit or currency
table child missing parent currency unit period or row path
number present in source text but outside the selected Evidence slot
date fiscal label rule number footnote and product-model false positives
count without currency including more-than qualifiers
numeric range temporal boundary and qualitative band
Writer emits context-only or forbidden candidate
model view masking and local inventory parity
market PIT price does not authorize valuation multiple fair value target price or recommendation
structured metric works when source_materials is empty
semantic Verifier false-pass remains blocked by the deterministic gate

stage_ownership.S1: Own source capture, parsing, source coordinates, Evidence selection and residual source gaps. Do not reopen the repaired bounded-anchor parser for this S2 defect.
stage_ownership.S2: Own candidate co-compilation, deterministic adjudication, stable fact and presentation programs, node-specific numeric views and final numeric promotion gate.
stage_ownership.S3: Own dynamic requests for additional numeric targets, evidence-to-mechanism reasoning, executable WWC and decision density after S2 provides a safe fact surface.
stage_ownership.S4: Own Workbench review surfaces for fact lineage, masked candidates and human correction; not part of this implementation package.
stage_ownership.S5: Own release evidence and migration proof after primary and held-out acceptance.

implementation_sequence.name: schema_and_pure_compiler
implementation_sequence.exit: MaterialNumericCandidateInventory and stable-fact presentation receipts compile deterministically from selected Evidence with zero model and network calls.

implementation_sequence.name: source_aware_adapters_and_adjudicator
implementation_sequence.exit: Structured metrics, table cells, bounded narrative, counts, percentages, ranges, temporal surfaces and PIT inputs are classified without regex-all promotion.

implementation_sequence.name: node_views_renderer_and_guard
implementation_sequence.exit: Research, Writer and Verifier views stay digest-aligned; unauthorized numeric spans cannot reach delivery and local rendering does not author analysis.

implementation_sequence.name: six_case_fake_capture_replay_and_mutation
implementation_sequence.exit: DELL, MU, NVDA and ORCL, ASML, ANET all pass their case matrix and all listed mutations fail closed where required.

implementation_sequence.name: clean_independent_zero_call_proof
implementation_sequence.exit: Two clean workers produce byte-equivalent inventories, model views, presentation programs and guard outcomes.

implementation_sequence.name: separate_natural_canary_and_rerun_decision
implementation_sequence.exit: Only after a separate authority decision may one minimal natural node canary determine whether a new DELL formal run is worth its cost.

non_goals: do not add three DELL-specific numeric aliases as the primary fix
do not promote every regex number from raw source text
do not weaken the deterministic financial gate
do not ask the model to count characters or hand-maintain IDs
do not reopen S1 retrieval or source parsing
do not absorb S3 WWC mechanism or density work
do not perform a DELL paid rerun or start another case
do not claim Owner acceptance release or production readiness
